children: Anthropic is building up its presence in Asia-Pacific to tap strong enterprise demand for its artificial-intelligence model Claude.
The San Francisco-based AI company plans to open an office in Singapore next month, bringing its regional count to five. It has offices in Tokyo, Bengaluru, Seoul and Sydney.

Chris Ciauri, managing director of international at Anthropic, said setting up shop in Singapore is a "natural next step" as Claude usage per capita in the city-state is among the highest in the world.

Anthropic said it will hire for a range of roles in Singapore, working with organizations across the private and public spheres. It noted especially strong demand in regulated sectors such as financial services and government.

Singapore is a standout market for Claude. Anthropic's most recent Economic Index ranks Singapore as No. 2 of 121 in Claude.ai usage relative to population. That rate is 5.81 times higher than would be expected based on population size, it said.
